body.x: M3 Solutions will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its new and improved Bettercog Pro and VR products.

Bettercog Pro, which will be introduced in the show, maintained the features of Bettercog, a cognitive rehabilitation program used by Center for Dementia nationwide for preventing mild cognitive disorder and dementia, with added features like pictures, sound, and touch to be used by illiterate people whom many are located in agricultural areas.

Therefore, this product can be released in various countries without any additional development as well as low-educated class and infants. Bettercog VR, a virtual reality cognitive rehabilitation training program that will also be displayed at the show, is a program that combines interesting elements with the aim of enhancing immersion and safe rehabilitation for the elderly by creating an environment similar to real life, and it is expected to show good results in combination with various products of Bettercog.

Bettercog is currently being distributed to about 50 centers for dementia, health centers, and hospitals in Korea, being used to prevent worsening of dementia. In 2019, the company exhibited at Global Sources Consumer Electronics in Hong Kong and received the Analyst’s Choice Award for outstanding product.

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
